findings.note: TEST-008 is explicitly only PARTIAL: the suite reconstructs a Facet Manifest by directly calling implementation functions and never validates the written facet-manifest.yaml required by AC-008. This does not satisfy T-005's pipeline-correctness Done When criterion.

Both digest stubs emit an unprefixed 64-hex value, while the dependency contract requires sha256:<64-hex>. A conforming Resolver should classify this as dependency-output-malformed, so fixtures reaching snapshot-generation-mismatch do not faithfully exercise the specified dependency contract.

TEST-016 deliberately excludes context_binding.full_context_revision and projection_sha256 from the advisory/required comparison. AC-016 states that only Resolver Evidence state may differ; weakening the oracle to ignore additional differing fields leaves the stated byte-identity criterion unmet.
